svg.title: LeadBoost to Mailer outreach lifecycle
svg.desc: Swimlane sequence across six lanes: user and frontend, LeadBoost API, LeadBoost database and jobs, Mailer API, Mailer database and worker, and SMTP and IMAP. It covers sender verification and mailbox synchronization, outreach approval and dispatch, durable acceptance, message generation, SMTP sending, IMAP reply intake, and the read-only conversation view, with failure and unknown paths.
svg.text: Accepted does not mean sent, and sent does not mean delivered. Dashed arrows are responses or polling.
LeadBoost verifies the mailbox; the Mailer receives the credential only here
LeadBoost authorizes; it sends no credential and no message text
Mailer worker only; never inside an HTTP request
Per-mailbox IMAP poll; bound to the mailbox's organization
LeadBoost displays the Mailer's record; it never heals or retries from here
sent once, only in this call
a safe code. A retry sends
Accepted, sent and delivered are three different facts: durably queued, SMTP handoff succeeded, and received.
No step in this flow observes delivery to the recipient's inbox. UNKNOWN means delivery is unconfirmed, not failed; the UI says not to resend.
